bundle_validation_rules.description: Bundle must contain at least 25 meaningful files
Any blocking EC category with status PENDING = INVALID_CLOSURE
Bundle cannot contain only sprint-state.json and bundle-manifest.json
Test counts claimed without log file is FAILURE
Regeneration count must be backed by per-example directory
Lane J PENDING while claiming COMPLETE is FAILURE
End-of-sprint git status required to prove committed clean state
commands.log must not be IN_PROGRESS at closure
